# Run 6 — sdh-spot-check, electron side: n = +3.2e12 cm^-2, D = 0, B 0 -> 10 T.
# Raw first, then onset + 1/B FFT vs F_L and the fs_count model.
from hera.analysis import sdh_onset, SdhOnsetError

run6 = run(6)
print(summarize_run(run6))
I_BIAS, SENS6 = 10e-9, 50e-6
B6 = run6.col("magnet_field"); R6 = run6.col("sr1_X") / I_BIAS
T6 = run6.col("T_sample")
FL6 = luttinger_frequency(3.2e16)   # (h/4e) n, n in m^-2 = 33.1 T
print(f"complete: {not run6.interrupted}; T {T6.min():.3f}-{T6.max():.3f} K; "
      f"R(0) = {R6[0]:.0f}, Rmax = {R6.max():.0f} Ohm ({R6.max()/(SENS6/I_BIAS)*100:.0f}% of 5 kOhm FS); F_L = {FL6:.1f} T")

on6 = sdh_onset(R6, B6, r_full_scale=SENS6 / I_BIAS)
print(on6.summary())

fig, ax = plt.subplots(3, 1, figsize=(9.5, 10))
ax[0].plot(B6, R6, lw=0.6)
ax[0].set(xlabel="B (T)", ylabel="Rxx (Ohm)", title="run 6 RAW: Rxx(B), n = +3.2e12, D = 0, T = 1.2 K")
m = B6 >= 0.9
p = np.polyfit(B6[m], R6[m], 5)
ax[1].plot(B6[m], R6[m] - np.polyval(p, B6[m]), lw=0.6)
ax[1].set(xlabel="B (T)", ylabel="dRxx (Ohm)", title="MR background removed (deg-5 in B, B > 0.9 T)")
for cut in (1.0, 1.5, 2.0):
    freqs, spec = sdh_fft(R6[:, None], B6, b_range=(cut, 10.0), bg_degree=5)
    ax[2].plot(freqs, spec[0] / spec[0].max(), lw=0.9, label=f"cutoff {cut:.1f} T")
ax[2].axvline(FL6, color="k", ls="--", lw=1, label=f"F_L = {FL6:.1f} T")
for f, lab in [(7.3, "ABAB light (model)"), (25.8, "ABAB heavy (model)")]:
    ax[2].axvline(f, color="tab:red", ls=":", lw=1)
    ax[2].text(f, 0.98, lab, rotation=90, fontsize=7, va="top", color="tab:red")
for k in (2, 3, 4):
    ax[2].axvline(k * 7.1, color="gray", ls=":", lw=0.7)
    ax[2].text(k * 7.1, 0.65, f"{k}x7.1", rotation=90, fontsize=6, va="top", color="gray")
ax[2].set(xlabel="F (T)", ylabel="norm. FFT amp", xlim=(0, 55),
          title="1/B FFT: tones vs F_L, model ABAB pair (red), harmonics of 7.1 T (gray)")
ax[2].legend(fontsize=8, loc="upper right")
fig.tight_layout()
dF6 = 1.0 / (1.0 / on6.onset_b - 1.0 / B6.max())
print(f"record resolution dF = {dF6:.2f} T (onset {on6.onset_b:.2f} T [censored: record low edge] -> 10 T)")

# Run 7 — sdh-spot-check, hole side: n = -1.2e12 cm^-2, D = 0, B 10 -> 0.3 T (ride-down).
from hera.analysis import sdh_onset, SdhOnsetError

run7 = run(7)
print(summarize_run(run7))
I_BIAS, SENS7 = 10e-9, 50e-6
B7 = run7.col("magnet_field"); R7 = run7.col("sr1_X") / I_BIAS
i7 = np.argsort(B7); B7, R7 = B7[i7], R7[i7]       # swept downward; sort ascending
FL7 = luttinger_frequency(1.2e16)   # n in m^-2 -> 12.4 T
print(f"complete: {not run7.interrupted}; R(0.3 T) = {R7[0]:.0f}, Rmax = {R7.max():.0f} Ohm; F_L = {FL7:.1f} T")

on7 = sdh_onset(R7, B7, r_full_scale=SENS7 / I_BIAS)
print(on7.summary())

fig, ax = plt.subplots(3, 1, figsize=(9.5, 10))
ax[0].plot(B7, R7, lw=0.6)
ax[0].set(xlabel="B (T)", ylabel="Rxx (Ohm)", title="run 7 RAW: Rxx(B), n = -1.2e12, D = 0, T = 1.2 K")
m = B7 >= on7.onset_b * 0.8
p = np.polyfit(B7[m], R7[m], 5)
ax[1].plot(B7[m], R7[m] - np.polyval(p, B7[m]), lw=0.6)
ax[1].set(xlabel="B (T)", ylabel="dRxx (Ohm)", title=f"MR background removed (deg-5 in B, B > {on7.onset_b*0.8:.2f} T)")
for cut in (0.71, 1.0, 1.5):
    freqs, spec = sdh_fft(R7[:, None], B7, b_range=(cut, 10.0), bg_degree=5)
    ax[2].plot(freqs, spec[0] / spec[0].max(), lw=0.9, label=f"cutoff {cut:.2f} T")
ax[2].axvline(FL7, color="k", ls="--", lw=1, label=f"F_L = {FL7:.1f} T")
for f, lab in [(1.2, "ABAB light (model)"), (11.3, "ABAB heavy (model, e-side val.)")]:
    ax[2].axvline(f, color="tab:red", ls=":", lw=1)
    ax[2].text(f, 0.98, lab, rotation=90, fontsize=7, va="top", color="tab:red")
ax[2].set(xlabel="F (T)", ylabel="norm. FFT amp", xlim=(0, 30),
          title="1/B FFT: near-CNP hole regime (recipe's stated low-|n| exception — tones close/beat-like)")
ax[2].legend(fontsize=8, loc="upper right")
fig.tight_layout()
dF7 = 1.0 / (1.0 / on7.onset_b - 1.0 / B7.max())
print(f"record resolution dF = {dF7:.2f} T (onset {on7.onset_b:.2f} T -> 10 T)")

**Read (runs 6–7).**

**Run 6 (electron, n = +3.2×10¹², F_L = 33.1 T)** — high-quality SdH: dominant fundamental at **7.1 T** (model ABAB light pocket: 7.3 T, i.e. global scale ≈ 0.97), oscillations alive down to the record's low edge (onset **censored ≤ 0.3 T** — good quantum mobility), light-pocket quantum limit visible as the deep minima at 6–7.5 T, QH regime above 8 T. Higher tones at **14.1 / 22.1 / 29.5 T** are flagged as the 2/3/4× comb of 7.1 — but the model puts the ABAB **heavy** pocket at **25.8 T** with 3×light = 21.9 T: at this single density the harmonic screen cannot separate a real heavy tone from the comb (δF = 0.31 T for the carrying tone, but the heavy-tone candidates have δF 1.6–2.4 T from their own onsets). This is exactly the investigation's warned failure mode — heavy/light drifts through 3× with density, and a ratio-only screen eats the real heavy tone there. **No clean singleton at F_L = 33.1 T** (weak ≤ 0.15-rel content near 33–36 T). The censored low-F tones (3.0/4.2/5.1/9.5 T) all onset at the record edge, inside the coarse 50 mT segment that undersamples the 7.1 T tone below ~1 T — suspected fold-down aliases (sdh-spot-check Verify); a grid change retires them.

**Run 7 (hole, n = −1.2×10¹², F_L = 12.4 T)** — multi-tone, beat-like set (6.6 / 9.4 / 4.7 / 8.5 / 12.3 T…), onset 0.71 T. This is the investigation's stated **near-CNP hole exception regime** (tones close and balanced), and the hole side is capped at n = −1.27×10¹² by the TG validator — it never reaches the template-separation densities |n| ≳ 2–3×10¹². Consistency data only; not the fan side.

**Verdict on the arc:** single-density reads are structurally ambiguous between **ABAB (light 7.1 + heavy ~22–26 T hiding in its own harmonic comb)** and **ABCA (would require the 7.1 T tone to be something else entirely — disfavored, since 7.1 tracks nothing in the ABCA template)**. The discriminator is the **n-trajectory**: model heavy/light ratio sweeps 9.8 → 3.5 across n = 1.2 → 3.2×10¹² while a harmonic stays pinned at exactly 3×; an ABCA singleton tracks F_L with no partner. → **Landau fan, electron side, D = 0** (investigation Step 4). Design handed to the measure notebook.

## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan, electron side (`landau-fan-vti`), D = 0, n = +0.8 → +3.2×10¹², B 0.8 → 10 T

> **05:30** · landau-fan-vti e-side: n +0.8..+3.2e12 (71 pts) at D=0, B 0.8->10 T uniform-1/B (116 rows, d(1/B)=0.0100), fast\_delay 1.8 s (6tau), sr1 100 uV, leak trip 1 nA; ends 10 T, gates parked 0 V · **ETA ~11:10** (≈5h40m)

**Why this fan (ana runs 6–7 read, cells 15–17):** the electron spot check resolved a dominant 7.1 T tone (model ABAB light pocket 7.3 T, scale ≈ 0.97) with a 2/3/4× comb — and the model puts the ABAB **heavy** pocket at 25.8 T vs 3×light = 21.9 T: at one density the harmonic screen cannot split them (the investigation's warned heavy/light ≈ 3× degeneracy). The discriminator is the **n-trajectory**: heavy/light sweeps 9.8 → 3.5 across this window (heavy − 3×light separation 6.4 → 3.9 T, all > 2δF) while harmonics stay pinned at integer multiples; an ABCA singleton instead tracks F_L with no partner. **Side:** electron only — the hole side is validator-capped at n = −1.27×10¹², inside the near-CNP exception regime (run 7 is correspondingly beat-like).

**Design (investigation Step 2/4, computed):** slow axis **uniform in 1/B**, Δ(1/B) = 0.0100 T⁻¹ = 1/(3·F_L(3.2×10¹²) = 33.1 T) → **116 rows**, 0.8 → 10 T ascending (magnet at 0, ends at 10 T — never re-traverses). δF = 1/(1/0.8 − 1/10) = **0.87 T**; heavy(25.8) vs ABCA-F_L(33.1) split 7.3 T ≫ 2δF ✓; ABAB partner ≥ 5 periods for n ≥ 2.25×10¹² (model f_partner, not the 0.28 ratio) ✓ over the claim window |n| ≳ 2–3. Fast axis n = +0.8 → +3.2×10¹² at D = 0 (run-5 cal), **71 pts** (Δn = 0.034×10¹²; ray floor 2.3–2.8 samples/ray at 0.8–1 T where ν > 130 and rays are thermally dead anyway, ≥ 8/ray at B ≥ 3 T where rays actually resolve — n-axis trimmed per the measurement-dominated branch). **Sensitivity 100 µV (10 kΩ FS)**: worst corner n = 0.8 × 10 T is ν ≈ 3.3 QH territory; run-4 lesson (≥10× the 1D max: 576 Ω at 10 T, run 7) sizes it — mid-B SdH at 0.1–1% FS is the accepted trade, runs 6/7 (50 µV) remain the amplitude reference. Dwell: fast_delay 1.8 s = 6τ (τ = 0.3 s / 24 dB, per-column-FFT settling per `landau-fan` step 7), slow_delay 1 s.

**Coverage trades, stated:** hole side excluded (validator-capped, exception regime — a hole fan would cost ~5 h for a resolvability-limited read); B < 0.8 T excluded (run-6 onset censored ≤ 0.3 T, so rows 0.3–0.8 T exist but cost ~+1.5 h for sub-5-period low-F content only); F > 49.7 T Nyquist ceiling (heavy-2nd-harmonic ~52 T folds weakly — noted for the FFT read).

**Price** (calibrated on runs 6/7: reads 0.08 s/pt on top of ramp + settle): grid 116 × 71 × 1.9 s = 4.35 h + traverse 9.2 T / 0.137 T/min = 67 min + row turnaround ≈ 6 min → **≈ 5 h 40 m**. **Checkpoints:** first 2–3 rows (~8 min: rail/clip, leakage, both channels live, B tracking); then periodic partial per-column FFT on landed rows at B ≈ 1.5, 2.5, 5 T (most rows land early on a 1/B grid) — continue/abort with the read stated. Leak guard trips at 1 nA. Aborting salvages: rows to ~2.5 T already improve run 6's n-resolution.

# === Landau fan (`landau-fan-vti`): electron side, D = 0, n = +0.8 -> +3.2e12, B 0.8 -> 10 T uniform-1/B ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
ns = np.linspace(0.8, 3.2, 71)                    # 1e12 cm^-2; dn = 0.0343e12
Ds = np.zeros_like(ns)
Vtgs, Vbgs = calc_gate_voltages(ns, Ds, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert Vtgs.min() >= TG_MIN and Vtgs.max() <= TG_MAX, (Vtgs.min(), Vtgs.max())
assert Vbgs.min() >= BG_MIN and Vbgs.max() <= BG_MAX, (Vbgs.min(), Vbgs.max())
print(f"fast axis: n {ns[0]:+.2f} -> {ns[-1]:+.2f}e12 at D = 0, {len(ns)} pts; "
      f"Vtg [{Vtgs.min():+.4f}, {Vtgs.max():+.4f}], Vbg [{Vbgs.min():+.4f}, {Vbgs.max():+.4f}] V")

# --- slow axis: uniform in 1/B (per-column SdH-FFT fan), Nyquist 1/3 per period of F_L(n_max) = 33.1 T ---
F_L_MAX = 33.085                                  # (h/4e) * 3.2e16
B_LO, B_HI = 0.8, 10.0
d_invB_target = 1.0 / (3 * F_L_MAX)
NB = int(np.ceil((1 / B_LO - 1 / B_HI) / d_invB_target)) + 1
invB = np.linspace(1 / B_LO, 1 / B_HI, NB)
B_vec = np.round(1.0 / invB, 4)                   # ascending 0.8 -> 10 T
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
assert (invB[0] - invB[1]) <= 1 / (2 * F_L_MAX), "B-axis under Nyquist floor"
print(f"slow axis: {NB} rows, B {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T, d(1/B) = {invB[0]-invB[1]:.5f} 1/T "
      f"({1/(3*(invB[0]-invB[1]))/F_L_MAX:.2f}x of 1/3-per-period at F_L={F_L_MAX:.1f} T)")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0, _tau = T_sample(), magnet.field(), sr1.time_constant()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: fan starts with the 0.8 T ramp), "
      f"V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), sr1 tau = {_tau} s / slope {sr1.filter_slope()} dB (fast_delay = 6 tau), "
      f"PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert abs(_tau - 0.3) < 0.05, "tau changed on the front panel — fast_delay=1.8 s keyed to 6*0.3 s"
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

I_TRIP = 1e-9
# Fixed sensitivity 100 uV = 10 kOhm FS at 10 nA: worst corner is low-n x high-B (n=0.8e12 at 10 T, nu ~ 3.3,
# QH-regime Rxx peaks kOhm-scale; session run-4 lesson: >=10x the 1D max, 576 Ohm @ 10 T run 7 -> >= 5.8 kOhm).
sr1.sensitivity(100e-6)
print(f"sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V (10 kOhm FS); mid-B SdH amplitudes ~10-100 Ohm = 0.1-1% FS — "
      f"resolution traded for headroom; runs 6/7 (50 uV) stay the amplitude reference")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"landau-fan-vti electron side: n +0.8..+3.2e12 (71) at D = 0 (run-5 cal), "
                  f"B 0.8 -> 10 T uniform-1/B ({NB} rows), slow_delay 1, fast_delay 1.8 (6 tau), sr1 100 uV")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan-vti')
s.add_comment(f'electron side, D = 0.00 V/nm, n = +0.80 to +3.20e12 cm^-2 (71 pts), '
              f'B = 0.8 to 10 T uniform-1/B ({NB} rows, d(1/B) = {invB[0]-invB[1]:.5f}); '
              f'cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}; '
              f'inherits run-6 settling (6 tau at tau 0.3 s)')

# row layout: [time, B, Vtg, Vbg, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr); s.plot('time', T_sample)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

try:
    s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtgs, Vbgs],
                     slow_delay=1, fast_delay=1.8)
finally:
    # park gates at 0 V (defined state); field stays where it is deliberately — at 10 T when complete;
    # the next move (LK ladder / hole-side ride-down / firming fan) is decided from this fan's read,
    # never re-traversing.
    s.ramp(k_tg.volt, 0.0); s.ramp(k_bg.volt, 0.0)
    print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, gates parked at 0 V")

              f'B 10 -> 0.3 T uniform-B 20 mT (ride-down); cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}')

s.plot(magnet.field, sr1.X); s.plot(magnet.field, sr0.X); s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[3])), abs(float(data[4]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.sweep(magnet.field, B_vec, delay=0)
# gates stay at the spot; field ends at 0.3 T — no park here.
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f})")
